details:
sense the game menu got updated people has not been able to force load avatars like before with the troubles of avatars either never or not loading or refusing to load because of too many avatars, even if people figured out two work-around fixes that either works or takes awhile to work, either a very quick turn off then turn on of their headset or switching from their headset menu back to the game both either once or twice.

the game should have a feature that allows people to force load avatars to fix the big problem people normally have with some or almost all avatars well playing vrchat so the work-around fixes are not needed unless its a device storage problem.

i do not know how pc and android players deal with it or have troubles with this but i know that they'd end up having this problem too only with either of the work-around fixes or both but different or neither, if the old work-around fix cannot be restored then the least that can be done is that the game updates anew feature to fix that or make a better work-around fix to help.

prevention of this problem will be of good help to everybody with this problem and struggle with having to deal with the problem.
title: Force Load Avatar Feature
